sources.title: gte tiny — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A featherweight specialist that punches above its size for embedding tasks. It trades raw capability for extreme efficiency — running comfortably on minimal hardware with fast inference times. The kind of model you deploy when resources are tight and you need semantic similarity or text encoding without the overhead of larger embedding models.
